products.title: Our Products
products.subtitle: Each creation tells a story of heritage, craftsmanship, and connection to the earth.
products.firstUseDesc: Soak the clay product in water for 4-6 hours before first use. This helps strengthen the clay and prevents cracking.
products.cleaningDesc: Wash with plain water or mild natural soap. Avoid harsh detergents and abrasive scrubbers that can damage the clay.
products.dryingDesc: Always air dry completely before storage. Never store wet clay products as moisture can weaken them.
products.cookingDesc: For clay cookware, always start with low to medium heat. Sudden temperature changes can cause cracks. Season regularly with oil.
products.storageDesc: Store in a dry, well-ventilated area. Stack with care using soft cloth between items to prevent chipping.
products.traditionDesc1: In today's world of plastic and synthetic materials, returning to clay is not just a choice — it's a statement. A statement about caring for our health, respecting our environment, and honoring our cultural heritage.
products.traditionDesc2: Our clay products fit seamlessly into modern homes while bringing the warmth and authenticity of traditional craftsmanship. Whether it's your morning chai in a kulhad, water from a matka, or meals from clay plates, each use is a small step toward a more sustainable and connected lifestyle.
products.traditionQuote: Every clay vessel is a bridge between our past and our future.

about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: A journey of preserving ancient traditions and connecting hearts through the art of clay.
about.para1: Shree Hari Mitti ke Bartan is a journey of faith, tradition, and craftsmanship.
about.para2: Every piece is handmade with devotion, without machines, without haste.
about.para3: True purity and beauty take time and care.
about.loveDesc: Every product is crafted with care and dedication, ensuring quality and authenticity in each piece.
about.communityDesc: Supporting local artisans and preserving traditional craftsmanship for future generations.
about.naturalDesc: Using only natural, chemical-free clay to create products that are safe and sustainable.
about.step1Desc: We carefully select the finest natural clay from local sources, ensuring purity and quality in every batch.
about.step2Desc: Skilled artisans shape the clay using traditional techniques passed down through generations.
about.step3Desc: Products are sun-dried naturally and then fired in traditional kilns to achieve durability and strength.
about.step4Desc: Each piece is inspected, finished, and blessed before it finds its way to your home.
about.quote: In every curve and contour, you'll find the dedication of hands that have mastered their craft over lifetimes.
about.heritageDesc: For thousands of years, clay has been at the heart of Indian households. From storing water in matkas to serving chai in kulhads, clay vessels have been symbols of purity, health, and connection to the earth.

workshop.title: The Workshop
workshop.para1: Step into our traditional workshop where generations of expertise meets passion for the craft. Every morning begins with preparing the clay, kneading it to perfection, ensuring no air bubbles remain.
workshop.para2: Our artisans work in harmony with the material, coaxing it into beautiful forms on the potter's wheel. The rhythmic spinning, the gentle pressure of skilled hands, and the slow transformation of shapeless clay into functional art — this is where magic happens.

firing.title: The Firing Process
firing.para1: After shaping, each piece must rest. Sun-drying is crucial, allowing moisture to evaporate naturally. This patience cannot be rushed — it's the clay telling us when it's ready.
firing.para2: The traditional kiln firing is an art in itself. Watching the clay transform under intense heat, gaining strength and its characteristic terracotta hue, is a sight that never loses its wonder. Each piece emerges tested by fire, ready to serve generations.

quality.title: Quality Check
quality.para1: Before any product leaves our workshop, it undergoes careful inspection. We check for structural integrity, finish quality, and that intangible quality — the soul of craftsmanship. Only pieces that meet our standards carry the Shree Hari name.
